name: Case Study Hero
description: A case-study header with a huge title, a meta grid, CSS-drawn laptop and phone mockups on a bold colour field, and a row of three result stats.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono line above the title, led by a dot in the cover colour.

props.name: index
props.description: Position in the series, top right.

props.name: title
props.default: "The weekly shop, done in four minutes."

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Part of the title set in italic serif in the cover colour. Must appear in title verbatim.

props.name: intro
props.description: Lead paragraph beside the meta grid.

props.name: meta
props.description: Client, year, role, deliverables. Array values render one per line.

props.name: stats
props.type: { value: string; unit?: string; label: string }[]
props.description: Three results. unit is set small in italic serif after the number.

props.name: coverColor
props.description: The cover field and accent colour (title emphasis, units, eyebrow dot).
